niche.title: The Circle of Willis Trap Most Students Fall For
niche.description:
Everyone learns the big vessels of the circle of Willis. Almost nobody remembers what closes the ring.

At the front the internal carotids give off the anterior and middle cerebral arteries. At the back the vertebrals unite as the basilar, which gives off the posterior cerebrals. Three communicating arteries close the circle: one anterior and two posterior. And the posterior cerebral arteries typically arise from the basilar, not the carotids.

niche.title: 8 Cranial Bones Mnemonic: Old People From Texas Eat Spiders | Skull Anatomy #shorts
niche.description:
Can you name all 8 cranial bones? One silly sentence does it: Old People From Texas Eat Spiders 🦴

O → Occipital: the back of your skull (the spinal cord exits through its foramen magnum)
P → Parietal: top and sides (a pair)
F → Frontal: your forehead
T → Temporal: right above your ears (a pair)
E → Ethmoid: tucked between your eye sockets
S → Sphenoid: the "keystone" that joins almost every other skull bone
6 names, but parietal and temporal come in pairs = 8 cranial bones.

Quick test: your spinal cord leaves the skull through which bone? Answer in the video.

niche.title: Brachial Plexus Made Easy: Draw It, Don't Memorize It | MBBS #shorts
niche.description:
Stop memorizing the brachial plexus. Draw it instead! ✏️

The Y and X trick:
• 5 roots: C5, C6, C7, C8, T1
• A Y joins them into 3 trunks: upper (C5, C6), middle (C7), lower (C8, T1)
• Each trunk splits into anterior and posterior divisions
• An X forms the 3 cords:
  - Posterior divisions of all three trunks → posterior cord
  - Anterior divisions of the upper and middle trunks → lateral cord
  - Anterior division of the lower trunk → medial cord

FMGE-style MCQ: Erb's palsy involves which roots?
A) C5, C6  B) C6, C7  C) C7, C8  D) C8, T1

niche.description:

Maxilla, Frontal, Zygomatic, Ethmoid, Lacrimal, Sphenoid, Palatine.
Lateral wall = zygomatic + greater wing of sphenoid (the strongest wall).
Medial wall = ethmoid (its paper-thin orbital plate, the lamina papyracea) + lacrimal, maxilla, sphenoid: the thinnest wall.
Roof = frontal + lesser wing of sphenoid. Floor = maxilla, zygomatic, palatine.
